objective: LungVision AI — Phase 6B Classification Performance Improvement & Controlled Architecture Experiments.
acceptance_criteria: Gate A: Baseline Reproduction (Reproduce existing model performance on NIH held-out test cohort; AUROC, AUPRC, Sensitivity, Specificity, Precision, F1, Brier score, ECE, confusion matrices, latency; export phase6b_baseline_reproduction.json).

Gate B: Aspect-Ratio-Preserving Preprocessing (Compare direct 224x224 resize vs letterboxed padding vs higher resolution; measure cardiac silhouette, lung boundary, distortion, landmark displacement; export phase6b_preprocessing_comparison.json).
Gate C: Resolution Experiments (Compare 224x224, 320x320, 384x384, 448x448, 512x512; compute memory consumption, training/eval time, latency, performance; export phase6b_resolution_ablation.json).
Gate D: Multi-Scale Architecture (Ablate FPN, multi-scale fusion, GAP vs GAP+GMP, SE attention, loss functions; export phase6b_multiscale_ablation.json).

Gate E: Class Imbalance & Label Quality (Analyze NIH distributions, missing labels, co-occurrence, label noise, BCE vs weighted BCE vs focal loss vs asymmetric loss; export phase6b_class_imbalance_analysis.json).

Gate F: Calibration & Threshold Evaluation (Compare frozen NIH thresholds, Youden thresholds, high-sensitivity operating points using validation data; export phase6b_calibration_threshold_report.json).
Gate G: Error-Specific Evaluation (Evaluate the 6 Phase 6 test images; measure probability changes with letterboxing and multi-scale features; export phase6b_six_image_comparison.json).
Gate H: Model Selection & Final Report (Multi-criteria validation selection; export phase6b_model_selection_report.json and author authoritative PHASE_6B_CLASSIFICATION_IMPROVEMENT_REPORT.md).
non_goals: Do not overwrite or modify production DenseNet121 weights (SHA-256: 8d3690cd0438587a94afb8fd2ad84c0b30f9c1cc2727ee0eb03662a02ea020af)
Do not alter frozen NIH production classification thresholds
Do not overwrite Phase 5B, 5C, 5D, or Phase 6 artifacts or delete checkpoints
Do not tune thresholds or select models using the final test cohort (prevent post-hoc data leakage)
Do not claim clinical diagnostic capability without external clinical trial validation
